svg.title: From wearable signals to movement-aware assistance
svg.desc: Four steps: acquire wearable signals, build a recent temporal window, recognize movement context, and use the estimate in assistance control. Conceptual summary, not an implementation specification.

g.text: A sequence matters more than a single instant
Measurements provide a view of ongoing motion.
Temporal patterns carry information about changing activity.
Machine learning connects signal patterns to activity or gait mode.
The estimate is one input to the robot's control strategy.
Conceptual overview · Study-specific sensors and algorithms are described in the papers.
